context: A boss and his manager debate political headlines
purpose: Teach: 公明党/火星/追悼/後退/帰還/露出/断言/賭け

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 見たか、公明党代表の昨日の演説。完全に一歩後退だな。
lines.en: Did you see the Komeito leader's speech yesterday? A complete step backwards.
lines.style: Gruff boss venting opinions before the morning briefing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、私も見ました。彼の支持率はもう戻らないと断言できますね。
lines.en: Yes, I saw it too. I can declare his approval rating won't recover.
lines.style: Measured manager agreeing with calm professional tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それより火星探査機の無事帰還、あれはすごいニュースだったぞ。
lines.en: More importantly, the Mars probe's safe return — that was huge news.
lines.style: Boss shifting topic with genuine excitement and admiration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に。亡くなった技術者の追悼式も同じ日にあったそうですよ。
lines.en: Truly. The memorial service for the late engineer was the same day.
lines.style: Solemn manager adding respectful context to the conversation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: メディアへの露出を増やすために、政治家は何でも利用するからな。
lines.en: Politicians will exploit anything to increase their media exposure, you know.
lines.style: Cynical boss grumbling with weary disapproval of politicians.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 次の選挙、与党が勝つほうに人生を賭けてもいいくらいです。
lines.en: I'd practically bet my life on the ruling party winning the next election.
lines.style: Confident manager making a half-joking strong prediction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おいおい、そこまで断言するか。世論は意外と簡単に動くもんだぞ。
lines.en: Hey now, you'd declare it that strongly? Public opinion shifts surprisingly easily.
lines.style: Boss pushing back skeptically with seasoned experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: では、負けたほうがランチを奢るという賭けでどうでしょう。
lines.en: Then how about a bet — loser buys lunch?
lines.style: Manager smiling and turning it into a friendly office wager.
